 '''''
 
+=== Governance Layers
+
+This page owns three related but distinct governance layers:
+
+* documentation governance for the curated docs surface
+* notes governance for the durable cognition layer
+* MCP stability governance for semver-facing tool contracts
+
+They live together because operators often need all three answers at the
+same time: what is authoritative, what is conditional, and what is
+stable enough to automate against.
+
+'''''
